subject.title: fix(cron): suppress control diagnostics in delivery

question: Should `NO_SUBPROCESS_STARTED` be a shared suppressed control reply for outbound cron delivery, or a Matrix-only cron exception?
rationale: Current main already has a shared suppression path, while this PR intentionally keeps non-Matrix delivery unchanged; that scope choice affects message-delivery semantics beyond a mechanical rebase.

options.title: Use Shared Control Reply Policy
options.body: Add the diagnostic to the shared classifier and cover cron delivery so all outbound channels treat the token consistently.

options.title: Approve Matrix-Only Exception
options.body: Keep suppression limited to Matrix cron delivery, but make that exception explicit in code and tests before merge.

options.title: Pause For Better Proof
options.body: Leave the PR open until the contributor supplies redacted real Matrix cron delivery evidence.

recommendation.title: Use Shared Control Reply Policy
recommendation.body: Add the diagnostic to the shared classifier and cover cron delivery so all outbound channels treat the token consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main cron delivery suppression path that this PR now needs to integrate with or intentionally diverge from.
